info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Tephroit Notebook Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Tephroit Notebook Detail Catalog API enables users to create and manage detailed entries for Tephroit notebooks within the catalog. This endpoint is designed for developers looking to streamline the process of adding detailed notebook information, including specifications and features. Primary consumers include application developers and product managers who require efficient catalog management and integration with their services. Utilize this API to enhance your product offerings and improve user experiences by ensuring accurate and comprehensive notebook availability.

post.summary: Create a new Tephroit Notebook detail.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new detail for the Tephroit Notebook. Providing the necessary data within the request body will result in the generation of a new entry in the notebook details.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit details related to the Tephroit notebook. It accepts a JSON object that includes all necessary information for processing the request. Ensure that all required fields are properly filled to avoid errors during processing.

200.description: The request was successfully processed, and the details are returned.
